records.failureSummary: Implemented and verified mergeConfig in src/merge.mjs (backend only). The prior attempt failed anti-tamper because it added cases to the protected file test/merge.test.mjs; this run restored that file to its original content (git status now shows only src/merge.mjs modified). The module is an ESM named export mergeConfig(base, override) with an isPlainObject predicate (non-null, non-array) and a deepClone helper. Per key: base keys are deep-cloned into a fresh result; override values that are undefined are skipped so the base value is preserved and keys absent from base are omitted (FR-3); null is assigned (FR-4); arrays and primitives are replaced directly (FR-5/FR-2); when both same-key values are plain objects it recurses and assigns the new merged object (FR-1). Non-plain-object roots return a deep clone of override (deep clone of base when override is undefined). No mutation of either argument. Verification: npm run test 2/2 pass, npm run build exit 0, npm run lint exit 0. pnpm is not installed in the sandbox so the underlying node scripts were exercised via npm.
